annotations.title: Prepare a draft for attorney review

description: Use to prepare a chronology, issue matrix, missing-document list, client email draft or research question list from the inquiry's documents. It is a draft for a lawyer to review, never sent or filed. Research lists name no case law or statute. For a lawyer or staff member of a law office signed in to ESQ CoPilot for their office. Do not call it for a person looking for a lawyer (use search_attorneys) or for general legal questions.
